title: ecdh-p384: HKDF-SHA384 instead of HKDF-SHA256
description: ecdh-p384 agree() currently uses wc_HKDF(WC_SHA256,...) regardless of curve. NIST SP 800-56C Rev 2 Table 2 requires P-384 to use SHA-384 for HKDF. Using SHA-256 with P-384 silently reduces effective security to 128 bits, negating the benefit of P-384. Fix: dispatch on ctx->curve_id in wolfssl_ecdh_agree() — WC_SHA384 for P-384, WC_SHA256 for P-256. Add known-answer test vector from independent oracle.
